openQuestions: All 41 Pontiac cards are skeleton "rodina" cards without photos, engines or dimensions; per-generation splits (Firebird, GTO, Grand Prix, Bonneville, Grand Am) and Commons photos were not added in this pass.
Cards carry isAddition:true while every line is also in model-lines-auto.json (and mirrored in model-line-additions.json). Which file is canonical for pontiac?
Card "1000" cites the 1984 Canadian Acadian brochure; the US 1000 should cite its own brochure. Its production end was set to 1986 because T-car production ended 23 Dec 1986 (model year 1987).
Card "six" mixes Pontiac 6 (1926-1932, 1935-1940) with Series 6-27 (1926-1927); years left null.
